name: Shane R. Ford
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Oakland, California
education: Golden Gate University School of Law
about: Shane R. Ford is the Managing Shareholder of The Ford Firm, PC and one of the most sought-after family mediators in Northern California. Mr. Ford is Fellow of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers (AAML) and is certified by the State Bar of California a Certified Family Law Specialist. He holds Martindale highest "AV Preeminent" ranking for legal ability and ethics, confirming his “very high to preeminent” reputation in the field of family law.

Mr. Ford is regularly voted by his peers as one of top family law attorneys and mediators in Northen California. Mr. Ford has been named a Northern California Super Lawyer every year since 2007, and one of the "Top 100 Attorneys" across all fields of law 19 times since 2007. In 2026, Super Lawyers recognized Mr. Ford as one of Northern California's "Top 5 Attorneys" in family law and one of Northern California's "Top 10 Attorneys" across all fields of law. In 2026, Mr. Ford's was selected by his peers for inclusion in Best Lawyers in America in the field of family law. Mr. Ford was named "Lawyer of the Year" in 2021 by Best Lawyers in America .

Mr. Ford is active in many family law organizations and he has served on the Boards of Directors for the Association of Certified Family Law Specialists (ACFLS), the Northern California Chapter of the AAML, the Association of Family and Conciliation Courts, California (AFCC), the Alameda County Family Law Association (ACFLA), and the Eastern Alameda County Family Law Association (EACBA).
A graduate of Illinois State University, Mr. Ford earned his law degree from Golden Gate University. He has been practicing family law exclusively in California since 1994.
